claims.claim: In cdc_system.transmute_jobs (101_create_transmute_jobs.sql) and cdc_system.transform_jobs (100_create_transform_jobs.sql), the status column is VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' with no CHECK constraint, and StuckJobReaper.reapOnce preserves 'PAUSED' while also healing rows where cancel_requested = true AND status = 'FAILED' AND error_message LIKE 'reaper:%' to 'CANCELLED'.

Demo P14-1 updates TestRequestCancel_RealLocalPostgres_ResolvesStuckJob in transmute_job_repo_test.go to use t.Skip / t.Skipf when config-local.yml, local PostgreSQL, or the target job record is unavailable.

Demo P14-2 and Demo P14-3 split the lifecycle and helper methods of TransmuteHandler (HandleTransmuteCancel, Start, recoverOrphanedTransmuteJobs, Stop, shadowMsgTracker) into transmute_handler_lifecycle.go and of BatchTransformHandler (HandleTransformCancel, Start, recoverOrphanedTransformJobs, Stop, finishJob, detectPrimaryKey) into batch_transform_lifecycle.go in the same packages without changing any method signatures.
